outcome: Requirement for oxygen and mechanical ventilation
Necessity for surfactant and inotropic support
cohort: The study included 183 pregnant women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) between 23 and 36 + 6 weeks gestational age who were admitted to a tertiary referral hospital.
finding: Neonatal mortality was primarily associated with low gestational age, low birth weight, and oligohydramnios, with RDS being the predominant cause of early deaths and sepsis for late neonatal mortality.
followup_time: Up to the late neonatal period (typically 28 days post-birth)
birth_weight: Measured and analyzed; lower birth weight was significantly associated with higher neonatal mortality.
